name: IUCN Save Our Species grants
summary: IUCN's species grant-making programme, which opens calls for proposals under donor-funded initiatives for projects that protect threatened species and their habitats.

applicant_types.quote: IUCN Save Our Species provides funding to civil society, Indigenous Peoples, researchers, youth and many other organisations working to protect and conserve threatened species.

access.quote: We regularly open calls for proposals for conservation projects.
